Ruth, I've scheduled the daily 'Strategic pod brief' for 07:45 Central, but it may not post tomorrow. The scheduler's gateway isn't running, so the job won't fire until someone starts it. I couldn't start it from here.

The brief will summarise new messages in #strategic-pod, #strategic-random and #inc-vtg-hartford, and post here. You're a member of all three channels. It leaves out finance figures and anything from DMs.

The scheduler works in UTC, so I set it to 12:45 UTC, which is 07:45 CDT. When US clocks go back on Nov 1 it will fire at 06:45 Central unless someone changes it to 13:45 UTC.

I've posted the same caveats in a reply to your message in #strategic-random.
